items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: for Dave to earn his money, he had to go shut the door. And I'd say, 'Goodnight,'... That's all I knew about Dave.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yes. In the studio there was a prop there for sound effects. And there was a door sitting over there, and by this time, there was no room for anymore bird whistles, so for Dave to earn his money, he had to go shut the door. And I'd say, 'Goodnight,' for no good reason at all, except, you know, to keep it in the song.
That's an entirely different version from the one you recorded in 1971?
